verdict.rationale: The docs describe a dashboard of every session showing which agents are working, need input, or are done. Worktree sessions let parallel agents run in isolated repo copies, and subagents and monitors can run in the background as independent child sessions. Auto mode, `/loop`, and headless/ACP give partial unattended autonomy and orchestration hooks. However, nothing shows agents running autonomously for hours or days, and dangerous tools may still prompt for approval. missing for 10: evidence of multi-hour/day unattended runs, cloud or remote fleet execution independent of the local machine, explicit fleet-launch tooling for many tasks at once, hands-on corroboration of parallel agent fleets.
